## ActionInputComponent

`class` from [`CoreCross/Component.js`](../../CoreCross/Component.js)

Exposes configured `ActionManager` values to a composed game entity.

## ActionManager

`class` from [`CoreCross/Input/ActionManager.js`](../../CoreCross/Input/ActionManager.js)

Maps game actions to one or more low-level keyboard or gamepad inputs. Use this layer in gameplay so controls can be configured per game while the `Input` class remains responsible for raw per-frame state.

**Example**

```js
ActionManager.MapAction("JUMP", [
Input.Keyboard("Space"),
Input.GamepadButton("A"),
]);
if (ActionManager.IsActionDown("JUMP")) player.Jump();
```

### Documented Methods

#### `static LoadMappings()`

Replaces all mappings using values loaded from a game config.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `configMappings` | `Object` | Map of action names to input rules. |

**Returns:** `void`
#### `static MapAction()`

Assigns rules for one action.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `actionName` | `string` | Game-defined action name. |
| `[rules=[]` | `Object[]` | ] - Rules produced by `Input.Keyboard` or gamepad helpers. |

**Returns:** `typeof ActionManager` - This action manager class.
#### `static IsActionDown()`

Tests whether any mapped input was pressed this frame.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `actionName` | `string` | Game-defined action. |

**Returns:** `boolean` - Whether the action went down.
#### `static IsActionUp()`

Tests whether any mapped input was released this frame.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `actionName` | `string` | Game-defined action. |

**Returns:** `boolean` - Whether the action went up.
#### `static IsAction()`

Tests whether an action currently exceeds its digital threshold.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `actionName` | `string` | Game-defined action. |

**Returns:** `boolean` - Whether the action is held.
#### `static GetActionValue()`

Reads the greatest mapped input strength, retaining analog axis intensity.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `actionName` | `string` | Game-defined action. |

**Returns:** `number` - Action value from zero to one.

## aStar

`function` from [`CoreCross/Pathfinding/AStar.js`](../../CoreCross/Pathfinding/AStar.js)

Finds a shortest grid path using a Manhattan-distance A-star search.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `grid` | `number[][]` | Grid whose zero entries can be walked. |
| `start` | `Object` | Starting `{x, y}` coordinate. |
| `goal` | `Object` | Destination `{x, y}` coordinate. |

**Returns:** `Object[]|null` - Ordered path or `null` when unreachable.

## Input

`class` from [`CoreCross/Input/Input.js`](../../CoreCross/Input/Input.js)

Manages per-frame keyboard, mouse, touch and polled gamepad input. Gamepad state is polled during the engine update so controllers already available to the browser are detected without reconnecting.

**Returns:** `Object`

**Example**

```js
import { Input } from "./Input.js";
if (Input.GetKey("ArrowUp")) {
// Execute some action
}
```

### Documented Methods

#### `static Update()`

Chamado pela Engine todo início de frame
#### `static LateUpdate()`

Chamado pela Engine todo fim de frame

## Store

`class` from [`CoreCross/Store.js`](../../CoreCross/Store.js)

This class is part of the EngineHtml5 framework and provides functionality to save and restore game state in the browser's local storage.

**Returns:** `Object`

**Example**

```js
var store = new Store();
store.SaveState({ level: 1, score: 1000 });
var state = store.RestoreState();
```

### Documented Methods

#### `SaveState()`

Saves the current state to local storage.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `Object` | The state object to be saved. |

**Returns:** `void`
#### `RestoreState()`

Restores the previously saved state from local storage.

**Returns:** `Object|null` - The saved state object or null if no state is found.
#### `ClearState()`

Clears the saved state from local storage.

**Returns:** `void`
#### `BackupState()`

Backs up the saved state to a different key in local storage.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `backupPrefix` | `string` | The prefix for the backup key. |

**Returns:** `void`
